title: engine_proposalLookaheadUpdatedV1 test vectors
description: Each vector is a request and the outcome an EL must return for it, whatever calls came before: the result null, or an error code. Only the code is checked; error messages differ between clients. Timestamps follow mainnet's genesis time (1606824023) and 12-second slots unless a vector says otherwise; an EL does not check them against a slot length.

vectors.name: two-proposals
vectors.description: Two proposals, one in the current epoch and one in the next, by validators with different fee recipients and target gas limits.

vectors.name: one-proposal
vectors.description: A single proposal.

vectors.name: empty
vectors.description: No proposals: the call clears the set.

vectors.name: max-entries
vectors.description: 256 proposals, the most a call may carry (more than EIP-7917's lookahead allows today).

vectors.name: past-entries
vectors.description: Entries already in the past, here the genesis slot and slot 1, are well-formed: the EL may ignore them, but the call succeeds.

vectors.name: slot-length-change
vectors.description: Timestamps 12 seconds apart and then 8, as across a fork that shortens the slot (EIP-8198): the EL checks only that timestamps increase, not their spacing.

vectors.name: max-values
vectors.description: The largest 64-bit values.

vectors.name: uppercase-hex
vectors.description: Upper-case hex digits, which the Engine API's encoding allows in QUANTITY and DATA.

vectors.name: too-many-entries
vectors.description: 257 proposals, otherwise well-formed.

vectors.name: missing-slot
vectors.description: An entry without slot.

vectors.name: missing-timestamp
vectors.description: An entry without timestamp.

vectors.name: missing-fee-recipient
vectors.description: An entry without suggestedFeeRecipient.

vectors.name: missing-target-gas-limit
vectors.description: An entry without targetGasLimit.

vectors.name: fee-recipient-null
vectors.description: suggestedFeeRecipient is null: all fields are required and not nullable.

vectors.name: slot-json-number
vectors.description: slot is a JSON number, not a QUANTITY string.

vectors.name: slot-leading-zero
vectors.description: slot has a leading zero, which QUANTITY does not allow.

vectors.name: timestamp-empty
vectors.description: timestamp is 0x, which encodes no value.

vectors.name: timestamp-no-prefix
vectors.description: timestamp lacks the 0x prefix.

vectors.name: gas-limit-over-64-bits
vectors.description: targetGasLimit is 2^64, one more than 64 bits hold.

vectors.name: fee-recipient-19-bytes
vectors.description: suggestedFeeRecipient is 19 bytes.

vectors.name: fee-recipient-21-bytes
vectors.description: suggestedFeeRecipient is 21 bytes.

vectors.name: fee-recipient-odd-length
vectors.description: suggestedFeeRecipient has an odd number of hex digits.

vectors.name: fee-recipient-not-hex
vectors.description: suggestedFeeRecipient holds characters that are not hex digits.

vectors.name: malformed-after-valid
vectors.description: A well-formed entry, then a malformed one: the EL validates the whole request, so the call fails and the set is left unchanged.

vectors.name: slot-repeats
vectors.description: two-proposals with the second slot equal to the first.

vectors.name: slot-decreases
vectors.description: Slots that decrease while the timestamps increase.

vectors.name: timestamp-repeats
vectors.description: Slots that increase, with the same timestamp.

vectors.name: timestamp-decreases
vectors.description: Timestamps that decrease while the slots increase.

vectors.name: proposals-not-array
vectors.description: A single entry passed as an object, not as an array of one.

vectors.name: proposals-null
vectors.description: proposals is null: an empty array, not null, clears the set.

vectors.name: no-params
vectors.description: The proposals parameter is missing.
